title: 化学实验室通用安全守则
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training Series/02_„General Laboratory Safety - Safety instructions.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training Series/02_„General Laboratory Safety - Safety instructions/src.py

points.K11: 装置不凑合，玻璃防烫防割
points.K15: 气体只在通风柜和密闭装置用
points.K16: 气瓶的存放、使用与搬运
points.K18: 电离辐射：未经许可不得进入
points.K21: 象形图、危险说明与低毒替代
points.K27: 洗手，工作服不出实验室
points.K35: 专注与敬畏，安全靠自己
points.S2: 国内报警电话与事故报告
points.S3: 管控类化学品依规管理

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一间整洁的化学实验室门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a tidy chemistry teaching lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲化学实验室的通用安全守则。
overlay: 化学实验室通用安全守则

shots.scene: 管理、防护、操作、应急四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a clipboard, a pair of safety goggles, a flask on a stand, and a first aid box. No people.
shots.narration: 从管理、防护、操作讲到应急。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着短裤拖鞋，嚼着面包，晃进实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in shorts and flip-flops strolls into the chemistry lab chewing a piece of bread.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次上化学实验课，啥也没准备。

shots.scene: 阿杰把面包放在试剂瓶旁，伸手去拿一瓶颜色鲜艳的试剂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his bread next to reagent bottles and reaches for a bottle of brightly colored powder with bare hands.
shots.narration: 面包放在试剂旁，空手就去拿试剂。

shots.scene: 小研快步过来拦住他，指着瓶上的象形图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hurries over, stops him and points at the hazard pictogram on the bottle.
shots.narration: 小研一把拦住：先看标签，再穿戴好！

shots.scene: 老周拿着空白的实验讲义走来，表情严肃
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks over holding a blank lab manual, looking serious.
shots.narration: 老周说：今天先学规矩，再做实验。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们一条一条来。

shots.scene: 老周站在学生中间讲解，学生们穿着实验服戴护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The older man explains to a group of students in lab coats and safety goggles in the teaching lab.
shots.narration: 实验课上，实验室负责人始终在场。

shots.scene: 学生举手提问，老周点头回答
shots.prompt_en: A student raises a hand to ask a question and the older man nods as he answers.
shots.narration: 有问题先找他，他的安全指令必须照办。

shots.scene: 老周指着一台仪器和一副护目镜讲解
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at an instrument and then at a pair of safety goggles while students listen.
shots.narration: 开工前，他会讲清技术、设备和防护。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在紧急喷淋下方，指向头顶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands under an emergency shower and points up at it, next to an emergency shower sign.
shots.narration: 进实验室，先认清应急设施。

shots.scene: 紧急喷淋、洗眼器、灭火器三个设施依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: An emergency shower, an eyewash station and a fire extinguisher light up one after another, each with its sign. No people.
shots.narration: 紧急喷淋、洗眼器、灭火器，

shots.scene: 通风柜、急救箱、紧急断电按钮依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood, a first aid box and a red emergency power-off button light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜、急救箱、紧急断电按钮，

shots.scene: 火灾报警按钮和墙上电话，旁边贴着空白应急电话卡
shots.prompt_en: A manual fire alarm call point and a wall telephone next to a blank emergency number card. No people.
shots.narration: 火灾报警按钮和应急电话。

shots.scene: 阿杰在平面图上标出每样设施的位置
shots.prompt_en: The young male student marks the location of each emergency device on a simple floor plan.
shots.narration: 在哪儿、怎么用，都要心里有数。

shots.scene: 老周向学生指出某台设备的特殊危险
shots.prompt_en: The older man points out a special hazard on a piece of equipment to the students.
shots.narration: 负责人要讲清特殊危险，监督防护。

shots.scene: 墙上张贴着空白的应急预案和安全须知
shots.prompt_en: A blank emergency plan and a blank safety notice posted at eye level on the lab wall. No people.
shots.narration: 应急预案和安全信息，贴在显眼处。

shots.scene: 老李给设备贴上空白的检测标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer sticks a blank inspection tag onto a lab device.
shots.narration: 需要定期检测的设备，按时检测。

shots.scene: 老周在空白风险评估表上填写并签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man fills in and signs a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 做风险评估，写下措施，记录效果。

shots.scene: 化学品柜旁一本空白的化学品清单和一摞说明书
shots.prompt_en: A blank chemical inventory binder and a stack of blank data sheets next to a chemical cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品要有清单，说明书随时可查。

shots.scene: 老周在电脑前编写空白的操作规程，屏幕只有图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man writes a procedure on a computer; the screen shows only blank lines and pictograms.
shots.narration: 特殊设备和危险化学品，要有操作规程。

shots.scene: 规程卡片上排着适用范围、危害、防护、故障几个图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure card with icons for scope, hazards, protective measures and malfunction. No people.
shots.narration: 写明适用范围、危害、防护和故障处理，

shots.scene: 规程卡片上排着急救、废弃、维护、违规后果几个图标
shots.prompt_en: The same card with icons for first aid, disposal, maintenance and consequences of violations. No people.
shots.narration: 还有应急急救、废弃处置和维护。

shots.scene: 规程挂在仪器旁，小研抬头阅读
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure sheet hangs beside an instrument and the female graduate student reads it.
shots.narration: 规程挂在仪器旁，人人都能看到。

shots.scene: 小研前一天晚上在宿舍翻看空白讲义做笔记
shots.prompt_en: The evening before class, the female graduate student reads a blank lab manual and takes notes.
shots.narration: 实验课前，先预习讲义。

shots.scene: 阿杰摊手说“到时候再说”的气泡图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shrugs; a speech bubble with a shrug icon above him is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 别指望到了现场才有人告诉你。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边，一件实验服和一副护目镜亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a lab coat and a pair of safety goggles that glow.
shots.narration: 实验服和护目镜，必须穿戴。

shots.scene: 阿杰换上长裤和包脚鞋，裤腿罩在鞋外面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student changes into long trousers and closed-toe shoes, with the trouser legs over the shoes.
shots.narration: 穿长裤和包脚鞋，裤腿不塞进鞋里。

shots.scene: 短裤、拖鞋、裙子、丝袜四个图标都被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of shorts, flip-flops, a skirt and nylon tights, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 短裤、拖鞋、裙子和丝袜都不行。

shots.scene: 小研把长发扎起；隐形眼镜图标打叉，框架眼镜打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties back her long hair; beside her a contact lens icon is crossed out and a glasses icon is ticked.
shots.narration: 长发扎起，近视戴框架眼镜。

shots.scene: 抽屉里排着几种不同的手套
shots.prompt_en: An open drawer holding several different types of protective gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 接触化学品要戴手套，

shots.scene: 小研对照空白说明书挑选手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank data sheet and chooses one type of glove.
shots.narration: 手套各不相同，要按化学品来选。

shots.scene: 小研在办公室里单独和老周小声交谈
shots.prompt_en: In a quiet office, the female graduate student speaks privately with the older man.
shots.narration: 怀孕或患有癫痫等慢性病，

shots.scene: 老周点头，在空白本子上记下调整安排
shots.prompt_en: The older man nods and notes an adjusted arrangement in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 要告诉负责人，好调整安排。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着门上方的绿色紧急出口标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at an emergency exit sign above the lab door.
shots.narration: 每个安全标志，都有特定含义。

shots.scene: 禁止、警告、指令、提示四类标志排成一行
shots.prompt_en: A row of four safety signs: a no open flame sign, a general warning sign, an eye protection must be worn sign, and an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 禁止、警告、指令、提示，要认得。

shots.scene: 一瓶试剂的标签上有骷髅象形图，旁边伸来的空手被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a skull and crossbones pictogram on a blank label; a bare hand reaching for it is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 试剂瓶上都有危险象形图。

shots.scene: 阿杰凑近看清标签，后退一步
shots.prompt_en: The young male student leans in, reads the pictograms on the label and steps back.
shots.narration: 看一眼标签，就知道它有多危险。

shots.scene: 实验台上的面包和水杯图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of bread and a drinking cup on a lab bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不准吃喝，

shots.scene: 实验室冰箱里放饮料的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lab refrigerator with a drink bottle inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也不准存放食品和饮料。

shots.scene: 阿杰把面包收进书包，到实验室外的休息区
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his bread back in his bag to eat later in a break area outside the lab.
shots.narration: 要吃东西，出实验室、洗了手再吃。

shots.section_title: 装置不凑合，玻璃防烫防割
shots.scene: 衣夹夹着烧瓶、面包机当热源、胶带缠水管的图标，全被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a clothes peg holding a flask, a toaster used as a heater, and a hose wrapped in tape, all crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 搭装置，不能凑合将就。
overlay: 装置不凑合，玻璃防烫防割

shots.section_title: 装置不凑合，玻璃防烫防割
shots.scene: 老周在通风柜里用铁架台和夹子把装置固定牢
shots.prompt_en: The older man firmly assembles glassware on a stand with proper clamps inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 用合适的夹具，装得稳、不别劲。

shots.section_title: 装置不凑合，玻璃防烫防割
shots.scene: 封闭的烧瓶加热示意图被打叉，旁边开口装置打勾
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a fully sealed flask being heated, crossed out, next to an apparatus with an open vent, ticked. No people.
shots.narration: 要有泄压口，不能搭封闭体系。

shots.section_title: 装置不凑合，玻璃防烫防割
shots.scene: 刚出烘箱的玻璃器皿看起来和冷的一样，旁边有热浪图标
shots.prompt_en: Glassware just out of a drying oven looks the same as cold glass, with a heat wave icon above it. No people.
shots.narration: 热玻璃看着和冷的一样，会烫伤。

shots.section_title: 装置不凑合，玻璃防烫防割
shots.scene: 小研用耐热手套取玻璃器皿，地上碎玻璃用扫帚收起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes glassware out with heat-resistant gloves; broken glass is swept up with a brush and dustpan.
shots.narration: 玻璃易碎，碎片别用手捡。

shots.scene: 火焰图标靠近溶剂瓶，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A flame icon next to a solvent bottle with a flammable liquid warning sign, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 高温加上易燃溶剂，非常危险。

shots.scene: 通风柜里的回流装置，冷凝管里水流箭头流动
shots.prompt_en: A reflux setup inside a fume hood with arrows showing cooling water flowing through the condenser. No people.
shots.narration: 要用回流冷凝管，把溶剂留住。

shots.scene: 冷却水管接口处用管箍固定，旁边有水流指示器转动
shots.prompt_en: Cooling water hoses secured with hose clamps at their connections, next to a spinning water flow indicator. No people.
shots.narration: 冷却水要有流量指示，水管要卡牢。

shots.scene: 易燃物明火加热的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a flask of flammable liquid over an open flame, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃和不稳定的物质，不用明火加热。

shots.scene: 小研摇低升降台，加热浴迅速离开烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lowers a lab jack so the heating bath moves quickly away from the flask.
shots.narration: 热源放在升降台上，随时能撤下来。

shots.scene: 加热浴放稳，搅拌子转动，旁边温度计
shots.prompt_en: A heating bath sits firmly on a stirrer with a spinning stir bar and a thermometer beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 搅拌防暴沸，加热浴放稳、别超温。

shots.scene: 冰浴、杜瓦瓶两个容器并排
shots.prompt_en: An ice bath and a vacuum-insulated Dewar flask side by side on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 冷浴要选对容器，一般用杜瓦瓶。

shots.scene: 小研戴面罩、防冻手套，小心倾倒液氮，白雾升起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing a face shield and cryogenic gloves carefully pours liquid nitrogen into a small Dewar; white vapor rises.
shots.narration: 液氮极冷，会严重冻伤，

shots.scene: 防冻手套、护目镜、面罩三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: cryogenic gloves, safety goggles and a face shield. No people.
shots.narration: 戴防冻手套、护目镜，必要时戴面罩。

shots.scene: 排风口气流箭头，液氮罐旁标出通风
shots.prompt_en: Airflow arrows from a ceiling exhaust vent above a liquid nitrogen container. No people.
shots.narration: 倾倒要通风，容器不能完全密闭。

shots.scene: 液氮罐独自在电梯里，人在电梯外等候
shots.prompt_en: A liquid nitrogen container rides alone in an elevator while the young male student waits outside the doors.
shots.narration: 运液氮，人不能和它同乘电梯。

shots.scene: 液氮容器旁的火源和可燃物图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a flame and a piece of paper near a liquid nitrogen container, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 低温会凝出氧，周围不能有可燃物。

shots.scene: 小研对着灯光检查烧瓶有无裂纹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a flask up to the light to check it for cracks.
shots.narration: 减压用的玻璃器皿，先查裂纹，

shots.scene: 有裂纹的烧瓶向内塌陷的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a cracked flask collapsing inward under vacuum, with warning lines. No people.
shots.narration: 受损的玻璃会内爆。

shots.scene: 合格的高压釜上贴着空白的检验标签
shots.prompt_en: A small stainless steel pressure vessel with a blank inspection tag. No people.
shots.narration: 高压反应只能用合格的高压釜，

shots.scene: 压力表指针回到零后，老周才打开釜盖，旁边贴着空白标识卡
shots.prompt_en: The older man opens the vessel lid only after the pressure gauge needle returns to zero; a blank label card hangs on the setup.
shots.narration: 不超温超压，泄压后再开，装置要标识。

shots.section_title: 气体只在通风柜和密闭装置用
shots.scene: 通风柜里的气体接口和气瓶管路
shots.prompt_en: Gas outlets inside a fume hood connected by tubing to a gas cylinder outside. No people.
shots.narration: 气体来自气瓶或通风柜里的接口。
overlay: 气体只在通风柜和密闭装置用

shots.section_title: 气体只在通风柜和密闭装置用
shots.scene: 气体泄漏扩散到房间的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of gas leaking out and spreading into the room, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能让气体漏到实验室里，

shots.section_title: 气体只在通风柜和密闭装置用
shots.scene: 气体只在通风柜和气密装置里使用，两个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two ticked icons: a fume hood and a sealed gas-tight apparatus. No people.
shots.narration: 只能在通风柜和气密装置里用。

shots.section_title: 气体只在通风柜和密闭装置用
shots.scene: 几个颜色不同的气瓶，瓶身空白字样区被放大镜照亮
shots.prompt_en: Several gas cylinders of different colors; a magnifying glass highlights the blank name area on one cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶颜色各国不同，认准字样和标签。

shots.section_title: 气瓶的存放、使用与搬运
shots.scene: 带排风的气瓶柜里，气瓶被链条固定
shots.prompt_en: Gas cylinders secured with chains inside a ventilated gas cylinder cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶放在通风的气瓶柜里，
overlay: 气瓶的存放、使用与搬运

shots.section_title: 气瓶的存放、使用与搬运
shots.scene: 倒地的气瓶和阳光暴晒的气瓶图标，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fallen gas cylinder and a cylinder in hot sunlight, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 防倾倒、防高温，漏气能排走。

shots.section_title: 气瓶的存放、使用与搬运
shots.scene: 老李把减压阀拧到气瓶阀上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer screws a pressure regulator onto a gas cylinder valve.
shots.narration: 用气要装减压阀，

shots.section_title: 气瓶的存放、使用与搬运
shots.scene: 不用的气瓶戴上瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: A protective cap is screwed onto the valve of an unused gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 不用时瓶阀戴好保护帽。

shots.section_title: 气瓶的存放、使用与搬运
shots.scene: 老李用气瓶推车推着固定好的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer moves a strapped gas cylinder on a cylinder trolley.
shots.narration: 搬运气瓶，只能用专用推车。

shots.scene: 小研检查加热板的电线和插头，完好打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the cord and plug of a hot plate; a green tick appears.
shots.narration: 电器要按用途用，用前确认完好。

shots.scene: 湿漉漉的电器图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wet electrical device with water drops, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 受潮的电器，绝不能用。

shots.scene: 阿杰关掉冒火花的设备，挂上空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off a sparking device and hangs a blank out-of-service tag on it.
shots.narration: 坏了就关机、挂牌停用，

shots.scene: 老李持证维修；阿杰拿小刀修电线的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer repairs a device with proper tools; beside him an icon of a student cutting a cable with a knife is crossed out.
shots.narration: 找专业电工修，自己不能乱修。

shots.scene: 设备上贴着空白的定期检测标签
shots.prompt_en: A blank periodic inspection sticker on the back of a lab device. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室电器，还要定期检测。

shots.section_title: 电离辐射：未经许可不得进入
shots.scene: 阿杰想推门进入贴电离辐射标志的房间，老周伸手拦住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tries to push open a door with an ionizing radiation warning sign; the older man stops him.
shots.narration: 辐射工作场所，不能随便进。
overlay: 电离辐射：未经许可不得进入

shots.section_title: 电离辐射：未经许可不得进入
shots.scene: 王老师给学生上辐射安全培训，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a radiation safety training class in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 要经过专门培训，获得许可，

shots.section_title: 电离辐射：未经许可不得进入
shots.scene: 射线装置外罩上方警示灯亮起，旁边有电离辐射标志
shots.prompt_en: A shielded X-ray instrument enclosure with a glowing warning light on top and an ionizing radiation warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 只在指定场所，认准警示标志和灯，

shots.section_title: 电离辐射：未经许可不得进入
shots.scene: 小研胸前别着个人剂量计
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a personal dosimeter badge clipped to her lab coat.
shots.narration: 照射越少越好，按规定佩戴剂量计。

shots.scene: 绿色激光光路旁的激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A laser warning sign beside an optical table with a green laser beam path. No people.
shots.narration: 激光伤眼，使用区域要有标识，

shots.scene: 小研戴上专用激光防护眼镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on dedicated laser safety goggles before entering the laser area.
shots.narration: 必须戴专用的激光防护眼镜。

shots.scene: 普通护目镜挡激光的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of ordinary safety goggles in front of a laser beam, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 普通护目镜挡不住激光。

shots.scene: 化学品放进专用化学品柜
shots.prompt_en: Labeled reagent bottles placed on the shelves of a dedicated chemical storage cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品放在专用的化学品柜里。

shots.scene: 一张放大的空白标签，上面有象形图位置和几行空白
shots.prompt_en: An enlarged blank chemical label with a pictogram area and several blank lines. No people.
shots.narration: 每瓶都要有标签：名称、象形图，

shots.scene: 标签上依次亮起信号词框、用量框、供应商框
shots.prompt_en: On the blank label, a signal word box, a quantity box and a supplier box light up in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 信号词、危险和防范说明、供应商。

shots.section_title: 象形图、危险说明与低毒替代
shots.scene: 欣欣身后，九个危险象形图排成方阵
shots.prompt_en: Behind the panda mascot, nine hazard pictograms are arranged in a grid.
shots.narration: 危险象形图一共九个。
overlay: 象形图、危险说明与低毒替代

shots.section_title: 象形图、危险说明与低毒替代
shots.scene: 爆炸、火焰、圆圈上火焰三个象形图
shots.prompt_en: Three hazard pictograms in a row: exploding bomb, flame, and flame over circle. No people.
shots.narration: 爆炸、易燃、氧化，

shots.section_title: 象形图、危险说明与低毒替代
shots.scene: 气瓶、腐蚀、骷髅三个象形图
shots.prompt_en: Three hazard pictograms in a row: gas cylinder, corrosion, and skull and crossbones. No people.
shots.narration: 高压气体、腐蚀、急性毒性，

shots.section_title: 象形图、危险说明与低毒替代
shots.scene: 感叹号、健康危害、环境三个象形图
shots.prompt_en: Three hazard pictograms in a row: exclamation mark, health hazard, and environment. No people.
shots.narration: 感叹号、健康危害和环境危害。

shots.section_title: 象形图、危险说明与低毒替代
shots.scene: 一个H开头、一个P开头的编码卡片，后面数字空白
shots.prompt_en: Two blank cards, one starting with the letter H and one starting with the letter P, followed by blank boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 危险说明讲危害，防范说明讲做法。

shots.section_title: 象形图、危险说明与低毒替代
shots.scene: 苯的瓶子换成低毒溶剂的瓶子，箭头连接
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from a bottle with a health hazard pictogram to a bottle with a milder exclamation pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 能用低毒的，就别用高毒的。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰一起读空白的实验讲义和操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student read a blank lab manual and a blank procedure sheet together.
shots.narration: 动手前，读讲义、规程和标签，

shots.scene: 危害、防护、急救、处置四个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Four ticked icons: hazard, protection, first aid and disposal. No people.
shots.narration: 想清楚危害、防护、急救和处置。

shots.scene: 时钟图标和实验步骤条，中间标出一个可以暂停的点
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon above a row of experiment steps with one safe pause point marked. No people.
shots.narration: 时间不够，先定好能安全中断的节点。

shots.scene: 夜间无人值守的实验装置图标，旁边是空白审批单
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an unattended overnight experiment next to a blank approval form. No people.
shots.narration: 过夜实验，按学校规定审批、安排。

shots.scene: 小研开工前把试剂和器材在台面上摆齐
shots.prompt_en: Before starting, the female graduate student lays out all reagents and equipment neatly on the bench.
shots.narration: 试剂器材先备齐，别临时手忙脚乱。

shots.scene: 阿杰一边聊天一边倒液体，聊天气泡被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student chats while pouring liquid; a chat bubble above him is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 做实验要专心，别边聊边干。

shots.scene: 先水后酸的示意图：酸慢慢倒入水中打勾，水倒入酸打叉
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: acid slowly poured into water is ticked; water poured into acid is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 稀释酸，先放水，再慢慢加酸。

shots.scene: 没标签的罐子放在台面上，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An unlabeled tin can of liquid left on an open bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品要装在合适的容器里，

shots.scene: 小研给烧杯贴上标签，放进通风柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student labels a beaker and places it inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 贴好标签，放进通风柜或指定柜。

shots.scene: 老周看了标签点头，旁边有路过的学生
shots.prompt_en: The older man reads the label on the beaker and nods while another student passes by.
shots.narration: 标签要让旁人一看就懂有啥危险。

shots.scene: 通风柜开关和气流指示，小研按下开关
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses the fume hood's power switch and watches the airflow indicator.
shots.narration: 用通风柜，先开机，确认排风正常。

shots.scene: 前窗拉低时气流箭头被吸入柜内
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood with its sash pulled low; airflow arrows are drawn into the hood. No people.
shots.narration: 前窗拉低，排风效果才好。

shots.scene: 小研的手从前窗下方伸入操作，脸在窗外
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works with her hands under the lowered sash while her face stays outside.
shots.narration: 手从窗下或侧面伸进去操作。

shots.scene: 人把头伸进通风柜的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person putting their head inside a fume hood under the sash, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 头绝不能伸进通风柜。

shots.scene: 地上一小滩液体，小研先查看空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: A small liquid spill on the floor; the female graduate student first checks a blank data sheet.
shots.narration: 洒了先搞清是什么，再动手清理。

shots.scene: 专用吸附材料撒在液体上
shots.prompt_en: Absorbent material from a spill kit is spread over the liquid spill. No people.
shots.narration: 液体用专用吸附材料吸收，

shots.scene: 粉末上轻轻喷湿，防止扬尘
shots.prompt_en: A small powder spill is gently moistened to stop dust from rising. No people.
shots.narration: 粉末先润湿，别让它飞起来。

shots.scene: 收集物装进带标签的废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Collected spill residue goes into a labeled waste container with a hazard sign. No people.
shots.narration: 清理物按废物规定收好。

shots.section_title: 洗手，工作服不出实验室
shots.scene: 带蓝色污渍的手摸门把手，污渍蔓延到咖啡杯，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand with blue stains touching a door handle, with the stain spreading to a coffee cup, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 手上的化学品，会被带到别处。
overlay: 洗手，工作服不出实验室

shots.section_title: 洗手，工作服不出实验室
shots.scene: 阿杰摘下手套，在水槽认真洗手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes off his gloves and washes his hands thoroughly at the lab sink.
shots.narration: 做完实验，脱手套、认真洗手。

shots.section_title: 洗手，工作服不出实验室
shots.scene: 小研把实验服和护目镜挂进实验室的柜子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hangs her lab coat and goggles in a locker at the lab entrance.
shots.narration: 实验服护目镜放在指定柜子里，

shots.section_title: 洗手，工作服不出实验室
shots.scene: 穿着实验服去食堂的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person in a lab coat walking into a cafeteria, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不穿出实验室。

shots.scene: 火焰、爆炸两个象形图在一排试剂瓶上方
shots.prompt_en: Flame and exploding bomb pictograms float above a row of blank reagent bottles. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃易爆化学品，危险特别大。

shots.scene: 溶剂瓶放进带易燃标志的防火安全柜
shots.prompt_en: Solvent bottles are placed inside a fire-resistant safety cabinet with a flammable liquid warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃溶剂，远离火焰电火花，进防火柜。

shots.scene: 遇水起火的象形图，旁边一滴水被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A substance that releases flammable gas in contact with water pictogram, with a water drop crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 有的遇空气或水会自燃，

shots.scene: 锤子和摩擦图标靠近一个瓶子，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hammer and friction near a reagent bottle with an exploding bomb pictogram, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有的怕撞怕磨，要轻拿轻放。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着墙边的灭火器、灭火毯和沙箱
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a fire extinguisher, a fire blanket and a sand bucket by the wall.
shots.narration: 灭火器在哪、怎么用，先学会。

shots.scene: 不同火灾类别图标配不同灭火器
shots.prompt_en: Icons of burning solid, liquid and gas each linked to a dry powder fire extinguisher; a burning metal icon is linked to a sand bucket. No people.
shots.narration: 按火灾类别选灭火器，金属着火用沙。

shots.scene: 小研拉下紧急喷淋，给衣服着火的同伴冲水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls the emergency shower handle to drench a coworker whose sleeve has caught fire.
shots.narration: 身上着火，用紧急喷淋或灭火器。

shots.scene: 火势变大，学生们沿疏散方向撤离
shots.prompt_en: The fire grows and students leave the lab quickly following the emergency exit signs.
shots.narration: 火势大了，马上撤离。

shots.scene: 老周拨打电话，屏幕上显示119
shots.prompt_en: The older man dials a phone; the numbers 1 1 9 appear on the keypad.
shots.narration: 拨打119，说清地点、情况和伤员，

shots.scene: 老周握着电话耐心听，挂断图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds the phone and listens patiently; a hang-up icon beside him is crossed out.
shots.narration: 等对方问完，不要先挂电话。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓上，鼻子、嘴巴、皮肤三个入口亮起
shots.prompt_en: A simple human outline with the nose, mouth and skin highlighted as entry points. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品经呼吸、口和皮肤进入人体，

shots.scene: 气体分子飘进肺部的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of gas molecules being inhaled into the lungs. No people.
shots.narration: 最常见的是吸入。

shots.scene: 腐蚀、致癌、致畸几个危害图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of corrosion on skin, a health hazard symbol, and a developing baby outline. No people.
shots.narration: 有腐蚀，也有致癌、致畸等慢性危害。

shots.scene: 皮肤腐蚀图标标“不可逆”，血液流动图标标“及时处理”
shots.prompt_en: A skin burn icon next to a blood circulation icon with a clock, illustrating local and systemic effects. No people.
shots.narration: 局部腐蚀难恢复，中毒要及时处理。

shots.scene: 欣欣摆手，一只手和一瓶试剂之间隔着手套
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves a paw; beside it a gloved hand holds a reagent bottle.
shots.narration: 总原则：别让危险物质碰到你。

shots.scene: 实验室里绿色烟雾冒出，老周举手示意大家撤离
shots.prompt_en: Green smoke rises from a spill on the floor; the older man raises his hand and signals everyone to leave.
shots.narration: 出了事故，负责人立即组织撤离。

shots.scene: 关燃气阀、关水、拉电闸三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a gas valve turned off, a water tap turned off, and a power switch turned off. No people.
shots.narration: 能安全操作时，关燃气、水和电源。

shots.scene: 救人者没戴防护冲进烟雾的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a rescuer running into smoke without protection, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 救人前先保证自己安全。

shots.scene: 老周深呼吸，冷静地指挥
shots.prompt_en: The older man takes a deep breath and calmly directs students outside the lab door.
shots.narration: 保持冷静，慌乱只会添乱。

shots.scene: 小研拨打电话，屏幕显示120
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls for help; the numbers 1 2 0 appear on the phone keypad.
shots.narration: 有人受伤，拨打120。

shots.scene: 王老师在急救培训课上示范包扎
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator demonstrates bandaging at a first aid training class.
shots.narration: 人人都应参加急救培训。

shots.scene: 烫伤的手放在流动清水下冲
shots.prompt_en: A burned hand held under running cool water at a sink. No people.
shots.narration: 烧烫伤，用流动清水冷却。

shots.scene: 阿杰把头凑到洗眼器上，用手指撑开眼睑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses his eyes at an eyewash station, holding his eyelids open with his fingers.
shots.narration: 溅入眼睛，撑开眼皮用洗眼器冲。

shots.scene: 伤员被扶到窗边呼吸新鲜空气
shots.prompt_en: An injured student is helped to an open window to breathe fresh air.
shots.narration: 吸入有害气体，移到空气新鲜处。

shots.scene: 昏迷者侧卧在地，身上盖着毯子
shots.prompt_en: An unconscious person lies on their side in the recovery position, covered with a blanket.
shots.narration: 昏迷者侧卧，注意保暖。

shots.scene: 老周和小研在空白事故记录本上登记
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student fill in a blank accident record book.
shots.narration: 每次事故都要报告和记录。

shots.scene: 空气中的氧气和氮气分子之间混着有害颗粒
shots.prompt_en: Oxygen and nitrogen molecules float in the air mixed with a few harmful particles. No people.
shots.narration: 空气里可能混有有害气体和粉尘。

shots.scene: 小研戴上合适的口罩，在通风柜前操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a suitable respirator mask and works in front of a fume hood.
shots.narration: 需要时戴合适的呼吸防护用品。

shots.scene: 过滤式口罩在浓烟和缺氧环境中的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a filter mask in thick smoke with a low-oxygen symbol, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 浓度太高或缺氧，过滤式不管用。

shots.scene: 细小颗粒进入肺部和血管的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of fine dust particles entering the lungs and blood vessels. No people.
shots.narration: 细粉尘能深入肺部和血管。

shots.scene: 阿杰用洗瓶冲洗刚用完的烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses a just-used flask with a wash bottle.
shots.narration: 玻璃器皿用完，马上用低毒溶剂洗。

shots.scene: 干结的污垢图标被打叉，干净烧瓶打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a flask with dried-on residue crossed out, next to a clean flask with a green tick. No people.
shots.narration: 残留没干就好洗，洗不掉再找老师。

shots.scene: 废液倒进水槽，流向鱼群的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of waste liquid poured into a sink drain flowing toward fish, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 废液绝不能倒进下水道。

shots.scene: 通风柜里几个贴标签的废液桶，小研用漏斗倒入
shots.prompt_en: Inside a fume hood the female graduate student pours waste liquid through a funnel into one of several labeled waste containers.
shots.narration: 边做边清理，分类倒进废液桶。

shots.scene: 空白说明书中的“废弃处置”一栏被放大
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass enlarges the disposal section of a blank data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么处置，查安全技术说明书。

shots.section_title: 专注与敬畏，安全靠自己
shots.scene: 欣欣对着镜头，胸前举着一副护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot faces the camera holding a pair of safety goggles.
shots.narration: 实验室有危险，但不必害怕，
overlay: 专注与敬畏，安全靠自己

shots.section_title: 专注与敬畏，安全靠自己
shots.scene: 阿杰专注地做实验，小研在旁点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student works with full attention while the female graduate student nods beside him.
shots.narration: 专心致志，心存敬畏，开工前知危险。

shots.section_title: 专注与敬畏，安全靠自己
shots.scene: 一本空白安全手册和学生自己的手放在一起
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety handbook with a student's hand resting on it. No people.
shots.narration: 安全不能交给一部片子，要靠自己。

shots.scene: 王老师给新生上准入培训，学生在空白试卷上作答
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator runs an entry training session; students answer a blank quiz.
shots.narration: 进实验室前，先培训、考核合格。

shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三层图标从上到下排列
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked icons from top to bottom: a university building, a department building, and a laboratory door. No people.
shots.narration: 学校、学院、实验室三级管理，

shots.scene: 老周胸前别着空白的负责人牌
shots.prompt_en: The older man wears a blank name badge and stands at the lab door.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人是第一责任人。

shots.section_title: 国内报警电话与事故报告
shots.scene: 电话旁贴着119、120和学校值班电话卡
shots.prompt_en: A telephone next to a card with the numbers 1 1 9 and 1 2 0 and a blank campus duty number. No people.
shots.narration: 火警119，急救120，记下校内值班电话。
overlay: 国内报警电话与事故报告

shots.section_title: 国内报警电话与事故报告
shots.scene: 小研打电话向老周报告，箭头指向学院和保卫处
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student phones the older man; arrows point onward to the department office and the security officer.
shots.narration: 出事先报负责人，再报学院和保卫处。

shots.section_title: 国内报警电话与事故报告
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接到电话，在空白记录上记下
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers the phone at the campus duty desk and writes on a blank log.
shots.narration: 如实报告，不隐瞒、不拖延。

shots.section_title: 管控类化学品依规管理
shots.scene: 上锁的双人双锁试剂柜，两人各拿一把钥匙
shots.prompt_en: A locked chemical cabinet with two locks; the older man and the safety administrator each hold one key.
shots.narration: 剧毒等管控化学品，按国家规定管理。
overlay: 管控类化学品依规管理

shots.section_title: 管控类化学品依规管理
shots.scene: 空白领用登记本，有人在上面签字
shots.prompt_en: A blank sign-out logbook on a counter; a hand signs on it. No people.
shots.narration: 领用要审批登记，用多少记多少。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶贴着中文安全标签，旁边一份中文说明书
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a hazard label next to a blank safety data sheet booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品要有安全技术说明书和标签，

shots.scene: 小研把没有标签的瓶子交还给老周
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands an unlabeled bottle back to the older man.
shots.narration: 没有标签的试剂，不使用。

shots.scene: 废液桶上贴着空白的危险废物标签
shots.prompt_en: A waste container with a blank hazardous waste label attached. No people.
shots.narration: 危险废物贴好标签，分类暂存，

shots.scene: 老李把废物桶交给穿工作服的转运人员，上车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hands sealed waste containers to a uniformed collection worker loading a van.
shots.narration: 统一交给有资质的单位处置。

shots.scene: 墙上空白的疏散图，箭头指向安全出口
shots.prompt_en: A blank evacuation map on the wall with arrows pointing toward the emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 平时就要熟悉疏散路线和出口。

shots.scene: 学生弯腰捂住口鼻，沿走廊走向楼梯
shots.prompt_en: Students crouch low, cover their noses and mouths, and walk along a corridor toward the stairs.
shots.narration: 烟大时低姿捂鼻，走楼梯，

shots.scene: 着火时乘电梯的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an elevator with smoke during a fire, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 着火时不乘电梯。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白检查表巡查实验室
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator inspects the lab with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 实验室定期开展安全检查。

shots.scene: 阿杰发现漏水的冷却管，拍照报告小研
shots.prompt_en: The young male student notices a leaking cooling hose and reports it to the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 发现隐患及时上报，整改再用。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室中央，身后几个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in the middle of the lab with a row of icons behind it.
shots.narration: 最后，我们把要点串一遍。

shots.scene: 准入、预习、穿戴、标签四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a training certificate, a lab manual, safety goggles and a hazard label. No people.
shots.narration: 先准入、做预习、穿戴好、看标签；

shots.scene: 装置、气瓶、电器、通风柜四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a clamped flask, a chained gas cylinder, a plug, and a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 装置牢、气瓶稳、电器好、柜窗低；

shots.scene: 洗手、废液桶、灭火器、电话四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: hand washing, a labeled waste container, a fire extinguisher and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 勤洗手、废液分类，会灭火、会报警。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿戴整齐，在老周看护下认真做实验
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, properly dressed, works carefully while the older man watches and nods.
shots.narration: 阿杰这回，规规矩矩完成了实验。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室门口挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the lab door.
shots.narration: 安全靠自己，下课再见！
